sections.Profile:
"Radical!," released by Bally in 1990, is a four-player skateboarding game inspired by late-80s and early-90s skater culture, designed by Dan Langlois and Peter Perry with art by John Youssi. Three ramps give it a wide variety of shots, and its "Mega-Million" multiball jackpot awards anywhere from 3 to 10 million points.
